notes.subject: אשת חיל
notes.rationale: 'woman of valour/worth/virtue/noble character' — rendered meri i gat strong bilong en to keep the concrete sense of חיל (strength, force, wealth)

notes.subject: מפנינים
notes.rationale: 'pearls' vs 'rubies' (KJV) vs 'coral' — rendered pen bilong solwara (pearls)

notes.subject: Hariap Hariap
notes.rationale: כת הבראשית 1:2 עניין: 'ורחק' is 'far', rendered idiomatically as 'i stap Hariap Hariap'

translation: Meri i gat strong bilong en, husat i ken painim ⟨em⟩? Na valua bilong em i stap Hariap Hariap, olsem ol pen bilong solwara.
